recordLookups.name: Get_ChangeRequest_Record
recordLookups.description: Retrieves the ChangeRequest record using the input recordId to fetch Description, Cost_Impact__c, and Schedule_Impact_Days__c for display context
recordLookups.label: Get ChangeRequest Record

recordUpdates.name: Update_ChangeRequest_Record
recordUpdates.description: Updates the ChangeRequest record with approval outcome values collected from the Approval Screen including Internal Approved, Customer Approved, Revision No, Revision Approved Date, and Drawing URL
recordUpdates.label: Update ChangeRequest Record

screens.name: Approval_Screen
screens.description: Approval screen displaying read-only ChangeRequest context (Description, Cost Impact, Schedule Impact Days) and collecting approval outcome data from the approver (Internal Approved, Customer Approved, Revision No, Revision Approved Date, Drawing URL)
screens.label: Approval Screen

fields.name: descriptionDisplay
fields.description: Display field showing the Description from the retrieved ChangeRequest record as read-only context

fields.name: costImpactDisplay
fields.description: Display field showing the Cost Impact from the retrieved ChangeRequest record as read-only context

fields.name: scheduleImpactDaysDisplay
fields.description: Display field showing the Schedule Impact Days from the retrieved ChangeRequest record as read-only context

fields.name: internalApproved
fields.description: Input checkbox field for the approver to indicate internal approval status

fields.name: customerApproved
fields.description: Input checkbox field for the approver to indicate customer approval status

fields.name: revisionNo
fields.description: Input text field for the approver to enter the revision number

fields.name: revisionApprovedDate
fields.description: Input date field for the approver to enter the revision approved date

fields.name: drawingURL
fields.description: Input URL field for the approver to enter the drawing URL

variables.name: recordId
variables.description: Input variable that receives the ChangeRequest record Id from the Flow Orchestration step
